name: project-readiness
purpose: Evaluate whether a Product-Agent OS workspace has enough control-plane structure to begin scoped work.

readiness_transition_rules: Detection alone may set present_unverified, but never present_verified.
Applicable gates without required evidence are applicable_missing until a proposal, verified artifact, or explicit_gap_accepted is recorded.
Use not_applicable only with an applicability reason.
Use explicit_gap_accepted only with owner, reason, residual risk, and follow-up condition.

Use approval_required for external writes, hosted docs, production DB access, security-sensitive changes, release publishing, PR creation, hook activation, deployment without approval, tag without approval, publish without approval, active automation without manual stability, or other irreversible operations.

acceptance_scenarios_when_behavior_chang.applies_when: User-facing behavior, business rule, workflow, UI state, API semantics, or agent behavior changes.
acceptance_scenarios_when_behavior_chang.pass_condition: Set present_verified when acceptance scenarios map requirement -> scenario -> check -> evidence owner; use present_unverified for drafted scenarios and applicable_missing when no scenario/check exists.
acceptance_scenarios_when_behavior_chang.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only when RUNLOG names owner, reason, residual risk, and the fallback manual/eval check.
acceptance_scenarios_when_behavior_chang.residual_risk: Behavior can be implemented against vague requirements or untested edge cases.

domain_model_when_complex_domain.applies_when: Complex backend, workflow, enterprise, data-heavy, multi-service, or multi-context domain.
domain_model_when_complex_domain.pass_condition: Set present_verified when domain model or proposal covers bounded context, ubiquitous language, aggregate/invariant, and owner review; use applicable_missing when complexity applies and model/gap is absent.
domain_model_when_complex_domain.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted when complexity is judged low for the slice or owner accepts delayed modeling with residual risk.
domain_model_when_complex_domain.residual_risk: Code may encode hidden domain rules and make later refactors unsafe.

fsd_boundary_when_ui_grows.applies_when: Growing web UI or reusable component architecture with feature/slice boundaries or owner decision for Feature-Sliced Design.
fsd_boundary_when_ui_grows.pass_condition: Set present_verified when feature/layer/slice/segment/public API/import rule or stack-appropriate alternative is named; use not_applicable for backend, native, simple CRUD, or simple MVP work.
fsd_boundary_when_ui_grows.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted when UI owner accepts a temporary non-FSD structure with reason and cleanup trigger.
fsd_boundary_when_ui_grows.residual_risk: UI files can become tangled and hard to split across features.

frontend_methodology.applies_when: User-visible frontend, route/page, browser-rendered UI, reusable component, design-system primitive, Storybook, Playwright, visual, accessibility, responsive, performance or API/data UI work.
frontend_methodology.pass_condition: Set present_verified when frontend artifacts record user flow, component states, design-system boundary, API/data alignment, accessibility, keyboard/focus, responsive matrix, visual evidence, browser/runtime evidence, console status, interaction test evidence, performance budget, browser support and content/i18n; use present_unverified for detected frontend signals until current browser evidence exists.
frontend_methodology.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only when UI owner names reason, scope, residual risk, review date and follow-up; use approval_required before external visual service approval, hosted browser services, production-data screenshots or publication.
frontend_methodology.residual_risk: Detection alone does not prove UI completion, browser/runtime evidence, responsive behavior, accessibility or privacy-safe visual proof.

ai_eval_spec_when_ai_behavior_changes.applies_when: Prompt, model, RAG, tool, agent route, retrieval, ranking, or judge behavior changes.
ai_eval_spec_when_ai_behavior_changes.pass_condition: Set present_verified when baseline, dataset, rubric, threshold, rerun command, latency/cost policy, and failure examples are recorded; use present_unverified until eval rerun evidence exists.
ai_eval_spec_when_ai_behavior_changes.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only when owner accepts manual_eval_required for one iteration with threshold follow-up.
ai_eval_spec_when_ai_behavior_changes.residual_risk: AI quality can regress while deterministic tests still pass.

llm_ai_rag_readiness_when_ai_behavior_ch.applies_when: Prompt, model, structured output, tool/function/MCP, RAG corpus, retrieval config, agent route, guardrail, eval, latency/cost or safety behavior changes.
llm_ai_rag_readiness_when_ai_behavior_ch.pass_condition: Set present_verified when ai-behavior-spec.md, ai-eval-spec.md, eval-run-report.md, prompt-contract.md, model-decision-record.md, RAG source/retrieval evidence, grounding evidence, tool contract, approval boundary, cost and latency evidence are recorded; use present_unverified for detected AI/RAG signals until current eval/runtime evidence exists.
llm_ai_rag_readiness_when_ai_behavior_ch.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only when owner records reason, residual risk, review date and follow-up; use approval_required before tool writes, shell, money, data exposure, external model/eval calls or irreversible actions.
llm_ai_rag_readiness_when_ai_behavior_ch.residual_risk: Detection alone does not prove AI/RAG quality, grounding, safe tool use, approval sufficiency or cost/latency readiness.

quality_testing_evals_when_non_trivial_c.applies_when: Non-trivial product, code, docs, AI, runtime, UI, API, bugfix, refactor, migration, release or quality claim work.
quality_testing_evals_when_non_trivial_c.pass_condition: Set present_verified when quality_testing_evals evidence records quality_strategy_present, risk_based_scope_present, acceptance_traceability_present, test_first_or_gap_present, contract_check_present, runtime_evidence_present, manual_qa_evidence_present, visual_a11y_evidence_present, eval_spec_present, eval_rerun_evidence_present, current_evidence_before_completion, ci_quality_gate_present, flaky_test_policy_present, coverage_policy_present, test_data_privacy_present, bug_reproduction_evidence_present and regression_impact_present; use present_unverified for detected signals until current evidence is recorded.
quality_testing_evals_when_non_trivial_c.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only when owner names reason, scope, residual risk, review date and follow-up; use approval_required before external CI writes, remote reruns, production data use, or publication.
required_evidence: coverage is a signal, not proof
quality_testing_evals_when_non_trivial_c.residual_risk: Completion, readiness, release or quality claims can be made from stale evidence, coverage-only claims or file detection alone.

professional_code_authoring.applies_when: Non-mechanical code authoring, refactoring, bugfix, generated-code edit, dependency change, legacy cleanup, agent/subagent code handoff, or code-quality claim.
professional_code_authoring.pass_condition: Set present_verified only when coding-standard-checklist.md records local_style_conventions, existing_capability_scan, one_line_candidate, selected_leverage_path, rejected_alternatives, dependency_decision, smallest proven change, comment-noise review, abstraction justification when applicable, and current test/eval evidence; use present_unverified for detected code-authoring signals until current evidence exists.
professional_code_authoring.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only for docs-only, read-only, formatting-only, or tiny mechanical work when owner or agent records not_applicable reason, residual risk and follow-up trigger.
professional_code_authoring.residual_risk: AI agents can add custom-code bloat, unnecessary dependencies, shallow wrappers, comment noise, broad rewrites, or unsupported code-quality claims.

semantic_evidence_sufficiency.applies_when: High-risk, production, release, security-sensitive, AI or public-contract work needs proof that recorded evidence is sufficient for the real project risk, not only present as files.
semantic_evidence_sufficiency.pass_condition: Set present_verified only when owner_reviewed_evidence_sufficient_for_real_project_risk is recorded for current command/eval/runtime evidence; use present_unverified for detected evidence until owner review happens.
semantic_evidence_sufficiency.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only with owner, reason, review_date, downstream_risk and follow_up_condition; use approval_required before external writes, production data, release publishing, security-sensitive mutation or other irreversible action.
semantic_evidence_sufficiency.residual_risk: A grouped methodology packet can preserve evidence while still overstating readiness if sufficiency is not owner-reviewed.

runtime_methodology_packet_safety.applies_when: Runtime runner consumes methodology_synthesis, recommendation groups, source artifact ledger, owner questions or finish_options.
runtime_methodology_packet_safety.pass_condition: Set present_verified when methodology_packet, finish_options, owner_questions, safe_next_action, evidence_gaps and approval boundary are compact, redacted and schema-v1 compatible; methodology_detection_not_completion prevents readiness from detection alone.
runtime_methodology_packet_safety.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only when the runtime route is read-only and owner accepts missing packet fields with follow-up; use approval_required before scaffold, workspace write, publish, deploy, automation activation, production data access or external action.
runtime_methodology_packet_safety.residual_risk: A runtime route can dump every methodology gate, scaffold before approval, or convert a recommendation into an external action if finish options and approval boundaries are not enforced.

agent_skill_metrics_loop.applies_when: Agents, skills, subagents, automation candidates, router/tool policies, prompt or policy packs, guardrails, harness versions or agent eval workflow surfaces are detected.
agent_skill_metrics_loop.pass_condition: Set present_verified only when agent-skill-scorecard-ledger.md, agent-skill-evaluation-report.html, current metrics evidence, owner review, cadence recommendation, update candidates, rollback evidence and approval boundary are recorded; use present_unverified for detected surfaces until current evidence exists.
agent_skill_metrics_loop.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only when owner names reason, residual risk, review date and follow-up condition; use approval_required before modernization writes, live eval/model calls, external systems or automation activation.
agent_skill_metrics_loop.residual_risk: Detection alone does not prove metrics-loop readiness, owner approval, cadence sufficiency, report truth, automation safety or modernization rollback safety.

codex_agentic_workflow.applies_when: Product-Agent OS, Codex App, CLI, IDE extension, codex exec, GitHub Action, MCP, Agents SDK, automation, subagent, skill, plugin, hook, external write, approval boundary, memory or handoff work.
codex_agentic_workflow.pass_condition: Set present_verified when codex_agentic_workflow evidence records agentic_scope_classified, control_plane_present, source_of_truth_present, read_only_discovery_complete, model_reasoning_policy_present, fresh_context_handoff_present, ownership_split_present, subagent_parallelism_safe, approval_boundary_present, mcp_permission_review_present, hook_activation_approval_present, plugin_boundary_present, skill_promotion_evidence_present, automation_manual_stability_present, agent_eval_workflow_present, memory_policy_present and agentic_evidence_before_completion; use present_unverified for detected Codex assets until owner-reviewed evidence exists.
codex_agentic_workflow.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only when owner names reason, residual risk, follow-up condition and why no silent activation is still prevented; use approval_required before MCP, hook, automation, external writes, GitHub Action changes, production data or Agents SDK app orchestration.
codex_agentic_workflow.residual_risk: Detection alone does not prove safe activation, owner approval, current verification or correct runtime routing.

docs_tooling_decision.applies_when: New docs system, public docs, generated docs, API/UI/DB/code reference changes, or docs-as-code impact.
docs_tooling_decision.pass_condition: Set present_verified when docs-tooling-decision.md records selected tools, rejected tools, owners, commands, approval needs, and docs_as_code_impact status; use not_applicable for docs-light/internal-only work with reason.
docs_tooling_decision.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only when docs owner accepts missing tooling with residual risk and follow-up.
docs_tooling_decision.residual_risk: Docs tooling can be over-forced or skipped without a clear maintenance owner.

contract_docs_when_api_or_event_changes.applies_when: HTTP API, event, webhook, queue message, generated client, or integration contract changes.
contract_docs_when_api_or_event_changes.pass_condition: Set present_verified when OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, contract tests, generated client impact, or proposal is updated; use applicable_missing when contract change has no documented source.
contract_docs_when_api_or_event_changes.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted for internal-only prototype contracts with accepted consumer risk.
contract_docs_when_api_or_event_changes.residual_risk: Consumers can break without a visible contract change record.

api_contract_readiness_when_api_or_integ.applies_when: API & Integrations methodology (`api_integrations`), OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, gRPC/protobuf, JSON Schema, Pact, webhook/event, generated SDK, external provider, consumer, compatibility, auth/error contract, or external write change.
api_contract_readiness_when_api_or_integ.pass_condition: Set present_verified only when api_contract_source_present, api_consumer_map_present, api_breaking_change_reviewed, api_security_reviewed, api_error_contract_present, api_contract_test_matrix_present, event_delivery_contract_present, generated_client_manifest_present, external_write_approval_present, api_observability_contract_present, api_style_choice_recorded, and api_unsupported_claims_rejected are verified or explicitly gapped. Swagger UI is not source of truth, schema validation alone is not contract testing, OAuth alone is not complete security evidence, and GraphQL/gRPC/events are not universal defaults.
api_contract_readiness_when_api_or_integ.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only with owner, reason, review date, downstream consumer risk and follow-up condition. Use approval_required before external writes, generated client publication, provider mutation, production credentials, webhook registration, release publishing or other irreversible external action.
required_evidence: Problem Details or explicit error-model gap
api_contract_readiness_when_api_or_integ.residual_risk: Rendered docs, generated clients, schema validation or prose-only security notes can look complete while consumers, compatibility, authz, error semantics, events, SDK releases or external writes remain unsafe.

database_data_readiness_when_database_or.applies_when: Database & Data methodology (`database_data`), schema, migration, backfill, persistent data model, production data, PII, retention, deletion, backup/restore, data quality, data contract, lineage, RAG ingestion, runtime pipeline, query performance, index, constraint or transaction boundary changes.
database_data_readiness_when_database_or.pass_condition: Set present_verified only when database_inventory_present, database_dictionary_present, database_schema_source_present, database_migration_plan_present, database_expand_contract_reviewed, database_transaction_boundary_present, database_rollback_feasibility_present, database_backup_restore_evidence_present, database_data_classification_present, database_data_quality_contract_present, database_data_contract_present, database_lineage_present, database_performance_review_present, database_retention_deletion_policy_present, database_synthetic_fixture_policy_present, database_production_access_approval_present, database_constraints_integrity_review_present and database_unsupported_claims_rejected are verified or explicitly gapped. Schema-only artifacts, ORM models, generated ERDs and dbdocs are not safety proof.
database_data_readiness_when_database_or.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only with owner, reason, review date, downstream data/API/security/AI/release risk and follow-up condition. Use approval_required before DB introspection, production database access, production data access, migration execution, destructive cleanup, backup restore or retention mutation.
database_data_readiness_when_database_or.residual_risk: Data migrations, schema drift, retention changes, runtime pipelines or RAG ingestion can look complete while production access, rollback, data quality, constraints, lineage or privacy evidence remains missing.

release_version_impact_when_public_contr.applies_when: Plugin, package, API, SDK, public app, or public contract changes.
release_version_impact_when_public_contr.pass_condition: Set present_verified when SemVer/changelog/release impact and consumer notes are recorded; use not_applicable when no public contract changes.
release_version_impact_when_public_contr.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only when owner accepts no version impact for an internal-only change.
release_version_impact_when_public_contr.residual_risk: Public users can receive breaking changes without warning.

reproduction_evidence_when_bug_rescue.applies_when: Bug rescue mode, user reports broken behavior, repeated failed fixes, or unclear failure.
reproduction_evidence_when_bug_rescue.pass_condition: Set present_verified when failing command, log excerpt, regression test, screenshot, manual repro, or explicit no-repro stop condition exists; use applicable_missing before broad code edits.
reproduction_evidence_when_bug_rescue.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only for no-repro diagnosis packet with owner and residual risk.
reproduction_evidence_when_bug_rescue.residual_risk: Fixes may target symptoms rather than the actual failure.

approval_before_greenfield_scaffold.applies_when: Empty folder, idea-stage project, new product scaffold, or first vertical slice proposal.
approval_before_greenfield_scaffold.pass_condition: Set present_verified when selected direction, non-goals, first slice, and approval are recorded before applying scaffold/write proposal; use approval_required before external writes.
approval_before_greenfield_scaffold.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted when user explicitly requests research/spec only and no scaffold is applied.
approval_before_greenfield_scaffold.residual_risk: Scaffold can lock in unapproved scope or architecture.

integration_catalog_when_external_system.applies_when: Multiple integrations, webhooks, queues, external APIs, generated clients, auth providers, or third-party data flows exist.
integration_catalog_when_external_system.pass_condition: Set present_verified when integration catalog names systems, owners, auth, data exchanged, retry/idempotency, observability, rollback, and secrets policy; use not_applicable for simple local-only work.
integration_catalog_when_external_system.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted when no integration is touched or owner accepts delayed catalog with risk.
integration_catalog_when_external_system.residual_risk: External dependency behavior and secrets handling can stay implicit.

ownership_split_when_parallel_agents_use.applies_when: Complex system acceleration, parallel build request, subagent team, or worktree-based execution.
ownership_split_when_parallel_agents_use.pass_condition: Set present_verified when owned files/subsystems and forbidden files are non-overlapping, or work stays sequential; use not_applicable when parallelism is not used.
ownership_split_when_parallel_agents_use.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only when sequential fallback is chosen with reason.
ownership_split_when_parallel_agents_use.residual_risk: Parallel workers can overwrite each other or duplicate decisions.

pr_risk_review_when_review_mode.applies_when: PR review mode, diff-focused request, requested changes, or pre-merge quality gate.
pr_risk_review_when_review_mode.pass_condition: Set present_verified when changed areas, spec compliance, quality/risk verdict, missing checks, docs/release/security impact, and residual risk are named; use applicable_missing when diff context is absent.
pr_risk_review_when_review_mode.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted when no diff/change context exists and review stops at intake.
pr_risk_review_when_review_mode.residual_risk: Review may miss behavioral or release impact outside the touched files.

onboarding_map_when_legacy_repo.applies_when: Legacy repo onboarding, undocumented existing project, missing run/docs map, or first maintenance pass.
onboarding_map_when_legacy_repo.pass_condition: Set present_verified when entry points, run commands, docs debt, architecture clues, and verification status are recorded; use present_unverified until commands run.
onboarding_map_when_legacy_repo.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted when user requests only a narrow code change and accepts onboarding risk.
onboarding_map_when_legacy_repo.residual_risk: Work can proceed with false assumptions about how the system runs.

migration_plan_when_contract_or_data_cha.applies_when: API contract, schema, backfill, retention, compatibility, public consumer, or breaking data change.
migration_plan_when_contract_or_data_cha.pass_condition: Set present_verified when migration plan includes current/target state, compatibility, rollout, validation, rollback, owner review, and release impact; use applicable_missing before implementation when absent.
migration_plan_when_contract_or_data_cha.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted for prototype work with no persisted data or public consumers.
migration_plan_when_contract_or_data_cha.residual_risk: Contract/data changes can be irreversible or break consumers.

security_review_when_sensitive_surface.applies_when: Auth, authorization, permissions, payments, billing, secrets, PII, sensitive data, abuse controls, or external writes.
security_review_when_sensitive_surface.pass_condition: Set present_verified when security risk review covers threat surface, authn/authz, payment, secrets, sensitive data, abuse controls, tests, rollback, owner review, and approvals; use approval_required before sensitive external action.
security_review_when_sensitive_surface.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only when no sensitive surface is touched and reviewer accepts residual risk.
security_review_when_sensitive_surface.residual_risk: Security-sensitive changes can ship without threat and permission review.

security_privacy_compliance_when_sensiti.applies_when: Security, privacy or compliance methodology (`security_privacy_compliance`), authn/authz, permissions, secrets, PII, sensitive data, payment/billing, abuse controls, audit logging, supply chain, SBOM/provenance, CI permissions, AI/tool security, external writes, production data, policy changes, regulated, contractual or compliance overlays.
security_privacy_compliance_when_sensiti.pass_condition: Set present_verified only when security_sensitive_classification_present, threat_surface_present, security_risk_review_present, asvs_mapping_present, asvs_level_selection_present, secure_sdlc_ssdf_samm_present, api_security_scheme_present, authz_negative_tests_present, secrets_policy_present, data_classification_present, data_redaction_lifecycle_present, privacy_impact_record_present, external_write_approval_present, abuse_rate_limit_review_present, audit_logging_review_present, supply_chain_review_present, sbom_provenance_decision_present, ci_permission_review_present, ai_security_review_present, compliance_overlay_present, compliance_overlay_taxonomy_present, vulnerability_response_workflow_present, Codex Security scan status and security_evidence_before_completion are verified or explicitly gapped.
security_privacy_compliance_when_sensiti.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only with security/privacy/compliance owner, reason, residual risk, review date and follow-up. Use approval_required before payment/billing, production data, secret rotation, policy change, external security-system mutation, external write or publish action.
required_evidence: Codex Security scan status not requested/run/blocked
security_privacy_compliance_when_sensiti.residual_risk: Detection alone does not prove security, privacy, compliance, supply-chain, authorization, data redaction or Codex Security scan readiness. Docs-only security articles and keyword-only mentions must not become regulated/compliance blockers without touched sensitive surface or owner claim.

backend_readiness_when_backend_changes.applies_when: Backend methodology (`backend`), service, API, worker, queue, scheduler, remote dependency, production runtime, data consistency, config/secrets, security-sensitive backend, or rollback-relevant backend change.
backend_readiness_when_backend_changes.pass_condition: Set present_verified only when backend_service_boundary_present, backend_runtime_behavior_present, backend_dependency_failure_matrix_present, backend_observability_contract_present, backend_slo_or_gap_present, backend_health_probe_contract_present, backend_job_queue_contract_present, backend_data_consistency_strategy_present, backend_config_secrets_boundary_present, backend_security_reviewed, backend_rollback_plan_present, and owner-reviewed evidence sufficiency are verified or explicitly gapped. Risky production backend without service boundary, runtime/failure evidence, security route or rollback is blocker/high-risk; simple local/backend-light work can stay warning or not_applicable.
backend_readiness_when_backend_changes.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only with owner, reason, review date, downstream risk and follow-up condition; accepted gap downgrade applies only after those fields are present. Use approval_required before production data, external writes, secrets, deploy actions or irreversible side effects.
backend_readiness_when_backend_changes.residual_risk: Package docs do not prove backend runtime safety; logs-only observability and health-endpoint-only readiness can hide production failure modes.

platform_runtime_check_when_native_or_de.applies_when: Mobile/native, desktop/local-first, filesystem, local DB, background job, permissions, offline state, or platform runtime change.
platform_runtime_check_when_native_or_de.pass_condition: Set present_verified when platform build/run/log/screenshot/simulator/manual check is named; use present_unverified for detected platform clues until runtime evidence exists.
platform_runtime_check_when_native_or_de.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted for docs-only or non-runtime change with owner-approved manual OS gap.
platform_runtime_check_when_native_or_de.residual_risk: Code inspection can miss platform permission, packaging, or runtime failures.

ci_failure_evidence_when_ci_stabilizatio.applies_when: CI stabilization mode, flaky tests, failing hosted runner, or build pipeline diagnosis.
ci_failure_evidence_when_ci_stabilizatio.pass_condition: Set present_verified when failing job, command, logs, environment, deterministic/flaky classification, local reproduction or rerun evidence exist; use approval_required before remote CI mutation.
ci_failure_evidence_when_ci_stabilizatio.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted when CI context is unavailable and work stops at local reproduction plan.
ci_failure_evidence_when_ci_stabilizatio.residual_risk: CI fixes can mask flakes or mutate remote settings without diagnosis.

release_readiness_when_distribution_chan.applies_when: Package, SDK, plugin, public app, open-source release, marketplace submission, or distribution change.
release_readiness_when_distribution_chan.pass_condition: Set present_verified when release readiness covers scope, package metadata, version, SemVer, changelog, build/test/docs/security/license/artifacts, publish approval, rollback, and owner review; use approval_required before publishing/tagging/uploading.
release_readiness_when_distribution_chan.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted for internal-only unreleased work with residual risk.
release_readiness_when_distribution_chan.residual_risk: Release artifacts can be incomplete or externally published without approval.

plugin_success_metric_for_major_workflow.applies_when: New scenario workflow, new route, major Product-Agent OS behavior, or workflow quality change.
plugin_success_metric_for_major_workflow.pass_condition: Set present_verified when metric defines time-to-first-useful-artifact, false positive gate rate, scenario success rate, owner, and review cadence; use present_unverified until measurement baseline exists.
plugin_success_metric_for_major_workflow.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only when workflow is experimental and marked for follow-up measurement.
plugin_success_metric_for_major_workflow.residual_risk: Workflow changes can feel comprehensive while reducing actual user throughput.

root_cause_before_bug_fix.applies_when: Bug rescue mode, repeated failed fixes, ambiguous failure, or user reports unclear behavior.
root_cause_before_bug_fix.pass_condition: Set present_verified when reproduction, trace, hypotheses, eliminated causes, and chosen fix path exist before broad edits; use applicable_missing when patching starts without diagnosis.
root_cause_before_bug_fix.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted for one-line typo with obvious failing test and owner-accepted lightweight path.
root_cause_before_bug_fix.residual_risk: Repeated fixes can accumulate without addressing the cause.

no_placeholder_plan_when_plan_ready.applies_when: Implementation plan is produced for non-trivial product, code, docs, migration, eval, or release work.
no_placeholder_plan_when_plan_ready.pass_condition: Set present_verified when exact files, concrete steps, commands, expected outputs, rollback, evidence owner, and placeholder scan are present; use applicable_missing for vague validation or repeated-by-reference steps.
no_placeholder_plan_when_plan_ready.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted for mechanical docs/config edits with reduced plan and reason.
no_placeholder_plan_when_plan_ready.residual_risk: Plans can look complete while leaving key work unspecified.

two_stage_review_when_risky_or_parallel.applies_when: Parallel work, public contract, migration, security-sensitive, data, release-bound, or risky slice.
two_stage_review_when_risky_or_parallel.pass_condition: Set present_verified when review includes spec-compliance verdict first and quality/risk verdict second; use applicable_missing when a generic review replaces required staged review.
two_stage_review_when_risky_or_parallel.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted for narrow low-risk slice with single-review reason.
two_stage_review_when_risky_or_parallel.residual_risk: Generic review can miss requirement drift before judging implementation quality.

fresh_context_handoff_when_subagents_use.applies_when: Any subagent, parallel worker, worktree owner, or delegated role receives work.
fresh_context_handoff_when_subagents_use.pass_condition: Set present_verified when task packet includes complete context, source constraints, allowed sources, inputs used, owned files, forbidden files, expected evidence, output schema, stop conditions, and sequential fallback; use not_applicable for inline sequential work.
fresh_context_handoff_when_subagents_use.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only when no subagent is used and sequential fallback is explicit.
fresh_context_handoff_when_subagents_use.residual_risk: A worker can act on stale or incomplete context.

behavioral_eval_when_new_route_added.applies_when: New usage_mode, workflow, skill route, first response behavior, or shortcut-resistance behavior is added.
behavioral_eval_when_new_route_added.pass_condition: Set present_verified when prompt/session fixture proves expected route, minimum artifacts, forbidden actions, and residual risk; use present_unverified until eval is run.
behavioral_eval_when_new_route_added.accepted_gap: Use explicit_gap_accepted only for one experimental iteration marked manual_eval_required.
